signals.name: neglect
signals.label: neglected building complaint (city inspectors, last 12 months)
signals.where: Agency = 'Community Planning & Development' AND Incident_Address_1 IS NOT NULL AND Case_Status NOT LIKE 'Closed%' AND Case_Summary = 'Neglect'

signals.name: vacant
signals.label: vacant building complaint (city inspectors, last 12 months)
signals.where: Agency = 'Community Planning & Development' AND Incident_Address_1 IS NOT NULL AND Case_Status NOT LIKE 'Closed%' AND Case_Summary = 'Vacant'

signals.name: trash
signals.label: trash or junk in yard complaint (city inspectors, last 12 months)
signals.where: Agency = 'Community Planning & Development' AND Incident_Address_1 IS NOT NULL AND Case_Status NOT LIKE 'Closed%' AND Case_Summary IN ('Trash in Yard Violation','Outdoor Storage Violation','Inoperable Vehicle')

signals.name: weeds
signals.label: overgrown weeds complaint (city inspectors, last 12 months)
signals.where: Agency = 'Community Planning & Development' AND Incident_Address_1 IS NOT NULL AND Case_Status NOT LIKE 'Closed%' AND Case_Summary IN ('Weeds/Vegetation Violation','Weeds & Vegetation')

ui.name: Denver
ui.title_cos: Land Title Guarantee Company, First American Title, Chicago Title of Colorado, all in Denver
ui.title_call: Land Title Guarantee Company or First American Title
ui.law: Colorado lets you assign a purchase contract; sell only your contract, never the house, or you need a real estate license. Foreclosures go through the county Public Trustee without a court, and if the home is already in foreclosure the Colorado Foreclosure Protection Act requires a specific written contract with a right to cancel.
ui.groups: "Investment Community of the Rockies (ICOR)", "Denver Real Estate Investors", "Colorado Wholesale Deals"
ui.prefc: City complaints: Denver posts every 311 complaint sent to its neighborhood inspectors for the last 12 months. Neglected and vacant building complaints are the strong ones; weeds and trash often mean nobody is looking after the house. Deed type comes from the assessor's last recorded transfer.
ui.buyers_note: Companies that bought 2 or more houses in the last 18 months, from the county sale data, most active first. Skip the big institutions and builders; the 2 to 20 purchase LLCs are the ones who buy wholesale deals. Look up the owner on the Colorado Secretary of State and call.
ui.buyers_empty: No buyers found in the sale data yet.
ui.repairs: Repairs, Denver rough numbers per house: cosmetic 20-30k, kitchen+baths 35-60k, roof 12-22k (hail), furnace and AC 10-16k, sewer line 8-15k, foundation 10-30k, full gut 80-130k.
ui.sources: City and County of Denver assessor parcel layer (owner, mailing address, value, year built, last sale and deed type), Denver 311 complaints routed to neighborhood inspectors
